notes: Read from the official 2026 publication listed in sources on 2026-10-20. Not yet signed off.
Arizona withholding is a percentage of gross taxable wages that the employee chooses on Form A-4 (0.5% to 3.5% in half-point steps). The default when no form is on file is 2.0%, used here.

Arizona's agency site blocks automated downloads, so this was read from the 2026 A-4 and its employer instructions as quoted in search results, not from the PDF itself: confirm against the A-4 at sign-off.
